title: Data model for the Declaration of Performance of a Biocorner mortar product
description: CIRCULOOS data model for the Declaration of Performance (DoP) issued for a Biocorner bio-based mortar product, covering the certification body, the functional unit used for the declaration and the declared performance characteristics.

value.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: UN/CEFACT code of the unit of measurement of the value.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:DoP:<id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be DoP

name.description: Property. Unique identifier name of the Declaration of Performance document, following an internal naming convention including product reference, year, and version.

certificationBody.description: Property. Notified body or laboratory responsible for product performance assessment under the relevant regulatory framework. Includes certification system reference.

functionalUnit.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM or MTQ. Reference unit for performance declaration, typically expressed as mass or volume. Used as the basis for comparing performance across different product formulations.

performanceSummary.description: Property. Aggregated summary of essential performance characteristics declared for the product, including relevant mechanical, thermal, and physical properties with their units.

dateCreated.description: Property. Date at which the entity was created.
